Name: Stardew Vampire
Author: clumsyjackdaw
Description:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/clumsyjackdaw/Branding/refs/heads/main/The_Mod.png[/img]
Have you ever thought: "Stardew Valley is way too cozy, I would like it to be objectively worse"?
If so, this might be the mod for you. 

Take damage while outside? Check.
Wait all day before playing the game? Check.
Make everyone hate you by biting them? Check.

Take your chance, and become a vampire now!

To bite someone, just stand close and click b.
If the mod is in your mods file it is always running, so be sure to take it out if you do not want to play with it.
Or, if it's all too difficult for you, there may or may not be a fashionable accessory that can help you ;)

﻿[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/clumsyjackdaw/Branding/refs/heads/main/Installation.png[/img]
﻿1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download Content Patcher.
3. ﻿The mod has two versions. One where you sparkle in the sun and one where you do not. [b]Do not put both versions in your game at the same time.[/b]
4. Download "StardewVampire - Sparkle" [b]or[/b] "StardewVampire - No Sparkle".
5. Unzip the mod.
6. Put the unzipped folder in your mods folder.
7. Download "StardewVampire - Content"
8. Unzip the content pack.
9. Put the unzipped content pack in your mods folder.

You did it correctly if:
* Your mods folder contains the folders:
    * "StardewVampire", which contains:
        * manifest
        * StardewVampire.dll
    * "StardewVampire_content", which contains:
        * content
        * hats
        * manifest

If the mod is in your mods file it is always running, so be sure to take it out if you do not want to play with it.

Downloads.Description:
The mod the way it is intended. For the mod to work:
* Download and install "Stardew Vampire - Sparkle"
* Download and install "Stardew Vampire - Content"

Do NOT download and install both "Stardew Vampire - Sparkle" and "Stardew Vampire - No Sparkle".
